tour.title: Choose your level
tour.body: Start with a CEFR level, then switch any time.

tour.title: Browse the day
tour.body: Read news, culture and history in both text and audio.

tour.title: Learn the phrase
tour.body: Each level has one word, expression and history term.

tour.title: Practise actively
tour.body: Answer three short exercises to review what you learned.

tour.title: Export learned items
tour.body: Mark a phrase learned, then use Anki to download a tab-separated deck. This help button reopens the guide.

tour.title: Build your glossary
tour.body: Star items, export them to Anki, and keep your progress.
